assertions.subject: Alopecia areata
assertions.quote: Alopecia areata results from the autoimmune destruction of hair follicles

assertions.subject: Androgenic alopecia
assertions.quote: The actions of androgens, specifically dihydrotestosterone (DHT), in androgenic alopecia cause hair follicle miniaturization

assertions.subject: Telogen effluvium
assertions.quote: Telogen effluvium is usually a self-limiting disorder of hair loss

assertions.subject: Trichotillomania
assertions.quote: Trichotillomania is a repetitive, impulsive hair-pulling disorder

assertions.subject: Traction alopecia
assertions.predicate: hair loss due to tightly pulled hairstyles
assertions.quote: Traction alopecia is another behavioral variant due to tightly pulled hairstyles

assertions.subject: Lupus
assertions.quote: Lupus is a systemic disease that may cause either scarring (i.e., discoid lupus) or non-scarring forms of alopecia

assertions.subject: Tinea capitis
assertions.predicate: fungal invasion of the hair shaft
assertions.quote: Tinea capitis is an important consideration in pediatric populations as a fungal invasion of the hair shaft results in patches of hair loss

assertions.subject: Keratosis pilaris
assertions.quote: Abnormal keratinization causing increased cohesiveness of keratinocytes within the pilosebaceous unit is implicated in both acne vulgaris and keratosis pilaris

assertions.subject: Keratosis pilaris
assertions.quote: Specifically, follicular hyperkeratinization leads to the obstruction of the pilosebaceous unit in acne vulgaris and of hair follicles in keratosis pilaris
